title: Causal completion pull reports local request build, size and header-encoding refusals as origin_read_failed
outcome: A causal completion read that is refused locally while its request is built, size-checked or header-encoded, before anything is sent, names a local request check on the original row instead of origin_read_failed.
acceptance: In FederationRpcClient::request_once_within, a builder.build() failure, the PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE size refusal and an incarnation or authority header-encoding refusal are classified as local refusals before send, and the relay maps them to a typed pending reason with its own release condition; other request_once callers receive the same ApiError as before.
A behavioural test drives one such local refusal through the real causal read and asserts the typed reason, not origin_read_failed.
